$description: CephTrace design tokens: the single source for apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css (run `pnpm --filter @ceph/desktop tokens`). Taken from the approved design prototype (canvas v10, 2026-09-28). Contrast is enforced by src/styles/tokens.test.ts: text 4.5:1 on every surface, white on every fill 4.5:1, landmark marks 4.5:1 on the radiograph, focus 3:1.

components.tool-button: Square-cornered (radius sm), control fill + control-line border, text colour; pressed state = accent-fill with on-fill text. Used for actions that change the current view or data (Undo, Flip, Level, Restore, Calibrate, Model B, Planes).
components.nav-group: One rounded container (radius lg, bg fill, control-line border) holding the links that open another page, each ending in ›, in this order: Cross-check (danger tint + count badge), Superimposition, Export (accent-fill, primary). Always to the right of the case title, visually distinct from tool buttons.
components.primary-button: accent-fill background, on-fill text, weight semibold. Never accent (fails AA with white text).
components.status-chip: radius pill, size xs/sm, weight semibold; fills: ai-fill (AI · unverified), accent-fill (Verified), danger-fill (Models disagree / To review), ok-fill (Agreed/Installed).
components.landmark: AI: hollow circle 14 px (active 18 px) stroke 2 px mark-ai; verified: filled square mark-verified with 1.5 px white border; conflict: stroke 2.5 px mark-conflict plus spoke to model B; model B: 8 px diamond mark-b. Labels 12 px bold in the mark colour with a dark halo (white halo on paper).
components.loupe: Docked at the top of the inspector, 5× (⌥ 8×), crosshair, never over the film. Drag the ring or click to place; arrow keys nudge 1 px (⇧ 10 px).
components.overlays-panel: Left sidebar above Models: plane checkboxes with swatches, Profilogram (G), Background Radiograph / mm grid. Never floats over the film.
